text: Volume is not written into the trigger, and I concede that to minervini and wyckoff: h1_close_above:bar_high carries no day_vol test. It is not my gate either: day_vol 0.74 is a partial proxy only, fill_difficulty NOT_SERVED (R5), so it holds my conviction at 3. My ground: W, D and H1 all HH/HL with 9>21, D 0.5% under 20-day high, structure_shift ABOVE_STRUCTURE. Hold SUPPORT. I would not object to a volume note on the ticket.
